candidate_repair_review.HTTP429: No new retry in this scope; preserve existing outer recovery behavior.
candidate_repair_review.transport_classification_condition: The production bounded_async_client currently collapses network/protocol/proxy failures into httpx.TransportError and timeout categories into TimeoutException. A narrow Connect/Read/RemoteProtocol retry policy needs safe detailed adapter mapping plus a test through that real adapter; do not treat all generic TransportError as the approved categories.
required_preservation: One outer cancellation deadline covers DNS, connect, headers, body, backoff and all attempts; it is never reset per attempt.
Do not retry configured_delivery, model generation, request handling or the entire answer. Retry only the explicitly allowlisted read HTTP method.
Preserve exact group/actor/member/admin checks and fresh authorization before send.
Preserve request/source revalidation, lease acquisition/binding/prepare/SENDING/UNKNOWN/SENT order, budget owners and model/source boundaries.
Keep token-bearing URLs and exception chains out of errors/logs; only fixed safe failure categories or status numbers may escape.
meaningful_tests: Transient first failure then success produces at most2 reads and one send.
Second failure or total deadline/cancellation stops without a third read.
429/permanent status/invalid response/wrong identity produce no inner retry.
Cancellation during DNS/headers/body/backoff releases transport under shared20-second deadline.
Transient failure before initial authorization creates no lease/model work; source/request invalidation before subsequent protected action prevents send.
Send transport failure/429/5xx/unknown receipt still makes exactly one send and preserves UNKNOWN behavior.
Production bounded_async_client exception mapping is exercised, not only httpx.MockTransport injected directly.
